::: {.why}
You cannot yet tell a market maker from a pod shop from an allocator, and that distinction is what decides which firms you write to in eleven months.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Name six distinct businesses that operate in markets and, for each, say in one sentence where the revenue comes from.
- Say which of the six you are competing with as one person with a laptop, and which you are not.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>55 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Read the free introduction chapter of Pedersen's Efficiently Inefficient, all of it, in one sitting. It is the best short account of what each kind of firm does that exists outside a paywall.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Open reports/milestone-01-market-map.md in the work repo and draw the map: exchange, broker, clearing house, market maker, prop shop, multi-manager pod, long-only manager, allocator. Put an arrow for every payment and label it with what is being bought.
:::
:::
